'''Starforth''' was a heavyset [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] research [[Aide/Legends|assistant]] who worked for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Assigned to the [[Riverfall Wilds]] under [[Director/Legends|Director]] [[Nashal (individual)|Nashal]], he was the only survivor after a group of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Spy/Legends|spies]] posing as [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Death/Legends|attacked]] his group and [[Thief/Legends|stole]] their uniforms.<ref name="Into the Maw" />
